schedules.title: Daily Compiler Primary
schedules.prompt:
Operate only the Daily AI Brief Compiler in gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Resolve the target edition as the next America/Chicago calendar day. Read protected Compiler main contracts first. Reuse an existing shadow/YYYY-MM-DD execution if present; otherwise allocate exactly one. Complete EDITORIAL -> CONTENT -> IMAGES -> BUNDLE as far as possible, preserving every valid persisted output and never regenerating an accepted or ACCEPTED_LOCKED image.

IMAGE ROUTING IS STATE-DRIVEN. If contracts/image-contract.json has activation_status=proof_required, preserve the current pre-activation Compiler behavior: reader-story images use the existing deterministic Proposal 1R semantic diagram-spec/render/review path, exact persisted GitHub PNG review, and accepted image immutability. Do not attempt D0 native generation while proof_required. If activation_status=active, first require the exact daily-compiler-d0-activation-v1 PASS receipt and configured digest binding; then use only D0 Native Image Capsules for reader-story images and never use Proposal 1R as a reader-story fallback.

ACTIVE D0 RULES: one genuinely fresh story-only native ChatGPT image context per story/attempt; exact sealed generator prompt; no prior story/image/orchestration context; same-invocation capture of exact generated bytes; immutable raw Git persistence; deterministic 1200x630 contain/white normalization; exact persisted-asset Visual Review v3; two-phase acceptance; six-image Set Review v3; atomic ACCEPTED_LOCKED. Maximum four genuine visual-quality attempts per story; infrastructure failures consume zero attempts. Never regenerate ACCEPTED_LOCKED assets.

Never use Work, Codex, paid model/image APIs or services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner image transfer, owner-liveness, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous AI polling, or runtime software repair. Set BUNDLE_READY only when the image gate appropriate to the protected-main activation state passes. After BUNDLE_READY, deterministic GitHub compilation owns build/deploy/verification.

schedules.title: Daily Compiler Recovery 1
schedules.prompt:
Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. Find the newest nonterminal Compiler shadow edition; if none exists, exit without mutation. Read only its compiler-state.json first. Preserve the same execution and all completed semantic work. Never create another execution for the same edition, never reopen completed editorial/content work, never regenerate an accepted or ACCEPTED_LOCKED image, and never reopen a sealed bundle.

Resume the first incomplete semantic stage using persisted valid outputs. IMAGE ROUTING IS STATE-DRIVEN from protected main. If contracts/image-contract.json has activation_status=proof_required, preserve the existing pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path: reuse persisted specs/renders/reviews, render only missing deterministic Proposal 1R reader assets, review only exact persisted GitHub PNG bytes, and preserve accepted image immutability. Do not attempt D0 native generation while proof_required. If activation_status=active, require the exact digest-bound daily-compiler-d0-activation-v1 PASS receipt, then resume only the first incomplete D0 image operation using persisted packets, attempt history, raw/final receipts, reviews, set state, and accepted locks. Every new D0 generation requires a genuinely fresh story-only native ChatGPT context and same-invocation exact-byte capture before yielding. Infrastructure failures consume zero visual attempts; genuine visual failures are bounded to four attempts per story. Proposal 1R is forbidden as an active-D0 reader-story fallback.

Continue through as many safe remaining stages as possible toward BUNDLE_READY. If a genuine platform/software capability is unavailable, preserve completed outputs, persist the smallest exact blocker, consume zero visual attempts when it is infrastructure, and stop. Never use Work, Codex, paid APIs/services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner transfer, owner-liveness, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous polling, or runtime software repair.

schedules.title: Daily Compiler Recovery 3
schedules.prompt:
Operate only on gttome/Daily-AI-Brief-Compiler. Do not access or modify gttome/Daily-AI-Brief. First find the newest nonterminal Compiler shadow edition.

IF A NONTERMINAL EDITION EXISTS: read only its compiler-state.json first and preserve the same execution and all completed semantic work. Never create another execution for the same edition, reopen completed editorial/content work, regenerate an accepted or ACCEPTED_LOCKED image, or reopen a sealed bundle. Resume the first incomplete semantic stage using persisted valid outputs. IMAGE ROUTING IS STATE-DRIVEN from protected main. While contracts/image-contract.json has activation_status=proof_required, preserve the pre-activation Proposal 1R reader-image path, exact persisted GitHub PNG review, and accepted-image immutability; do not attempt D0 native generation. After activation_status=active plus an exact digest-bound daily-compiler-d0-activation-v1 PASS receipt, resume only the first incomplete D0 image operation using persisted packets, attempt history, raw/final receipts, reviews, set state, and accepted locks. Every new D0 generation requires a genuinely fresh story-only native ChatGPT context and same-invocation exact-byte capture before yielding. Infrastructure failures consume zero visual attempts; genuine visual failures are bounded to four attempts per story. Proposal 1R is forbidden as an active-D0 reader-story fallback. Continue as far as safely possible toward BUNDLE_READY.

IF NO NONTERMINAL EDITION EXISTS: use this same existing schedule as the bounded D0 completion lane; do not create another schedule or control plane. Read protected main contracts/image-contract.json, docs/D0-PROOF-STATUS.md, contracts/d0-p0a-route-matrix.json, and the preserved rehearsal branch rehearsal/d0-fused-live-proof-r1 execution-state.json/manifest.json. If D0 is proof_required and the route matrix is BLOCKED, perform only a bounded current capability recheck using authoritative OpenAI product documentation plus actually available ChatGPT/GitHub/file tool surfaces. Do not spend a native image to discover infrastructure. Update a route to READY only when one zero-cost native route demonstrably provides all seven P0-A capabilities simultaneously: native ChatGPT Images, genuinely fresh story-only context, exact story-prompt binding, programmatic generated-asset retrieval, exact bytes before context end, post-generation persistence, and unattended invocation; every prohibited dependency must remain false. 'Ignore prior context' is never isolation proof. If no route is READY, exit without image generation and preserve all proof state.

When a route first becomes READY, resume the EXISTING rehearsal/d0-fused-live-proof-r1 at its first incomplete operation; do not create another proof execution. Use its sealed six packets, two first-attempt stress cases, route gate, durable attempt history and accepted locks. Reuse completed P0-B and P0-C; never rerun them. The six-image fused rehearsal must supply P0-A, formal P0-D, P0-E and P0-F with zero extra promotion generations. Require exact raw-byte capture, deterministic 1200x630 normalization, exact persisted Visual Review v3, strict text/brand compliance, six-image Set Review PASS and atomic acceptance. After those formal proofs PASS, use the existing deterministic completion/activation applicators on a protected PR, require exact-head CI, merge only the proven activation change, and rely on the already state-driven four Compiler schedules to switch to D0 automatically.

After D0 activation, if no current nonterminal edition exists and the preserved October 7 same-execution image-only migration is still incomplete, resume that migration only from shadow/2026-10-07 and its d0-image-migration-plan.json. Preserve execution_id daily-compiler-shadow-2026-10-07 and semantic_rework=0; never redo October 7 semantics or create another execution. Generate/review/lock only missing D0 replacement images, require the six-image D0 set gate, then use the deterministic migration applicator, rebuild/deploy through protected GitHub workflows, and verify exact live image bytes. Preserve accepted images across restarts.

At every stage: never use Work, Codex, paid model/image APIs or services, billable overage, new paid infrastructure, alternate accounts, owner transfer/upload, owner-liveness, Supervisor, Watchdog Ring, leases, persistent workers, wake PRs, continuous polling, or runtime software repair. If a genuine platform capability is unavailable, preserve completed outputs, persist the smallest exact blocker when a durable location exists, consume zero visual attempts for infrastructure, and stop.
